            if (! this.shareData) {\n
                return null;\n
            }\n
\n
            if (this.attributedShareData) {\n
                return this.attributedShareData;\n
            }\n
\n
            const params = new URLSearchParams({\n
                url: this.shareData.sourceUrl,\n
                text: this.shareData.shareText,\n
                title: this.shareData.fallbackTitle,\n
            });\n
            const response = await fetch(`${this.shareData.payloadEndpoint}?${params.toString()}`, {\n
                headers: {\n
                    Accept: 'application/json',\n
                },\n
            });\n
\n
            if (! response.ok) {\n
                return this.shareData;\n
            }\n
\n
            const payload = await response.json();\n
            this.attributedShareData = {\n
                ...this.shareData,\n
                url: payload.url,\n
                tracking_token: payload.tracking_token ?? null,\n
            };\n
\n
            return this.attributedShareData;\n
        },\n
        async sharePayloadForChannel(provider = null) {\n
            const shareData = await this.resolveShareData();\n
\n
            if (! shareData || ! provider || ! shareData.tracking_token) {\n
                return shareData;\n
            }\n
\n
            try {\n
                const shareUrl = new URL(shareData.url, window.location.origin);\n
                shareUrl.searchParams.set(this.providerQueryParameter, provider);\n
\n
                return {\n
                    ...shareData,\n
                    url: shareUrl.toString(),\n
                };\n
            } catch (error) {\n
                return shareData;\n
            }\n
        },\n

            const shareData = await this.resolveShareData();\n

            const csrfToken = document.querySelector('meta[name=csrf-token]')?.content;\n

                headers: {\n

                    'Content-Type': 'application/json',\n
                    'X-CSRF-TOKEN': csrfToken,\n
                },\n
                body: JSON.stringify({\n

                }),\n
            });\n
        },\n

            if (! shareData) {\n
                return;\n
            }\n

                window.prompt('Copy this link:', url);\n

                    return;\n

                }\n
            }\n

            initiallyGranted = false,\n
            cookieName = 'public_geolocation_permission',\n
        } = {}) => ({\n
            geolocationPermitted: Boolean(initiallyGranted),\n
            geolocationPermissionCookieName: cookieName,\n
            init() {\n
                this.syncGeolocationPermission();\n
            },\n
            persistGeolocationPermission(granted) {\n
                document.cookie = `${this.geolocationPermissionCookieName}=${granted ? '1' : '0'}; path=/; max-age=31536000; SameSite=Lax`;\n
            },\n
            setGeolocationPermission(granted) {\n
                this.geolocationPermitted = Boolean(granted);\n
                this.persistGeolocationPermission(this.geolocationPermitted);\n
            },\n
            async syncGeolocationPermission() {\n
                if (!('geolocation' in navigator)) {\n
                    this.setGeolocationPermission(false);\n
\n
                    return;\n
                }\n
\n
                if (!navigator.permissions || typeof navigator.permissions.query !== 'function') {\n

                }\n
\n
                try {\n
                    const permissionStatus = await navigator.permissions.query({ name: 'geolocation' });\n
                    const applyPermission = () => this.setGeolocationPermission(permissionStatus.state === 'granted');\n
\n
                    applyPermission();\n
\n
                    if (typeof permissionStatus.addEventListener === 'function') {\n
                        permissionStatus.addEventListener('change', applyPermission);\n
\n
                        return;\n
                    }\n
\n
                    permissionStatus.onchange = applyPermission;\n
                } catch (error) {\n

                }\n
            },\n

    <script\n
        defer\n
        data-signals-tracker\n
        src="https://ilmu360.test/api/signals/tracker.js"\n
        data-endpoint="https://ilmu360.test/api/signals/collect/pageview"\n
        data-event-endpoint="https://ilmu360.test/api/signals/collect/event"\n
        data-identify-endpoint="https://ilmu360.test/api/signals/collect/identify"\n
        data-anonymous-cookie-name="mi_signals_anonymous_id"\n
        data-session-cookie-name="mi_signals_session_id"\n
        data-write-key="NFNsGSNZX8Tvx4W31Io4whYSMhBEA4ZbakLe5Lvf"\n

            <script>\n
            (() => {\n
                window.ilmu360 = window.ilmu360 || {};\n
\n
                if (window.ilmu360.signalsUiInitialized) {\n
                    return;\n
                }\n
\n
                window.ilmu360.signalsUiInitialized = true;\n
\n
                const storageValue = (storage, key) => {\n
                    try {\n
                        return storage.getItem(key);\n
                    } catch (error) {\n
                        return null;\n
                    }\n
                };\n
\n
                const persistStorageValue = (storage, key, value) => {\n
                    try {\n
                        storage.setItem(key, value);\n
                    } catch (error) {\n
                    }\n
                };\n
\n
                const readCookie = name => {\n
                    const prefix = `${name}=`;\n
                    const cookies = document.cookie ? document.cookie.split(';') : [];\n
\n
                    for (const cookiePart of cookies) {\n
                        const cookie = cookiePart.trim();\n
\n
                        if (cookie.startsWith(prefix)) {\n
                            return decodeURIComponent(cookie.slice(prefix.length));\n
                        }\n
                    }\n
\n
                    return null;\n
                };\n
\n
                const writeCookie = (name, value, maxAgeSeconds = null) => {\n
                    let cookie = `${name}=${encodeURIComponent(value)}; path=/; SameSite=Lax`;\n
\n
                    if (typeof maxAgeSeconds === 'number') {\n
                        cookie += `; Max-Age=${maxAgeSeconds}`;\n
                    }\n
\n
                    if (window.location.protocol === 'https:') {\n
                        cookie += '; Secure';\n
                    }\n
\n
                    document.cookie = cookie;\n
                };\n
\n
                const activeConfig = () => {\n
                    const configured = window.ilmu360.signals || {};\n
\n
                    if (configured.writeKey && configured.eventEndpoint) {\n
                        return configured;\n
                    }\n
\n
                    const script = document.querySelector('script[data-signals-tracker][data-write-key]');\n
\n
                    if (! script) {\n
                        return null;\n
                    }\n
\n
                    return {\n
                        surface: script.dataset.surface || 'public',\n
                        eventEndpoint: script.dataset.eventEndpoint,\n
                        anonymousCookieName: script.dataset.anonymousCookieName || 'mi_signals_anonymous_id',\n
                        sessionCookieName: script.dataset.sessionCookieName || 'mi_signals_session_id',\n
                        writeKey: script.dataset.writeKey,\n
                        externalId: script.dataset.externalId || null,\n
                        email: script.dataset.email || null,\n
                    };\n
                };\n
\n
                const anonymousIdentifier = config => {\n
                    const storageKey = `signals:anonymous:${config.writeKey}`;\n
                    const existing = storageValue(localStorage, storageKey) || readCookie(config.anonymousCookieName);\n
\n
                    if (existing) {\n
                        persistStorageValue(localStorage, storageKey, existing);\n
                        writeCookie(config.anonymousCookieName, existing, 31536000);\n
\n
                        return existing;\n
                    }\n
\n
                    const created = `sig_anon_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)}${Date.now().toString(36)}`;\n
\n
                    persistStorageValue(localStorage, storageKey, created);\n
                    writeCookie(config.anonymousCookieName, created, 31536000);\n
\n
                    return created;\n
                };\n
\n
                const sessionIdentifier = config => {\n
                    const storageKey = `signals:session:${config.writeKey}`;\n
                    const existing = storageValue(sessionStorage, storageKey);\n
\n
                    if (existing) {\n
                        writeCookie(config.sessionCookieName, existing);\n
\n
                        return existing;\n
                    }\n
\n
                    const created = `sig_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)}${Date.now().toString(36)}`;\n
\n
                    persistStorageValue(sessionStorage, storageKey, created);\n
                    persistStorageValue(sessionStorage, `signals:session-started-at:${config.writeKey}`, new Date().toISOString());\n
                    writeCookie(config.sessionCookieName, created);\n
\n
                    return created;\n
                };\n
\n
                const sessionStartedAt = config => {\n
                    const storageKey = `signals:session-started-at:${config.writeKey}`;\n
                    const existing = storageValue(sessionStorage, storageKey);\n
\n
                    if (existing) {\n
                        return existing;\n
                    }\n
\n
                    const created = new Date().toISOString();\n
\n
                    persistStorageValue(sessionStorage, storageKey, created);\n
\n
                    return created;\n
                };\n
\n
                const parseProperties = value => {\n
                    if (! value) {\n
                        return {};\n
                    }\n
\n
                    try {\n
                        const parsed = JSON.parse(value);\n
\n
                        return parsed && typeof parsed === 'object' && ! Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed : {};\n
                    } catch (error) {\n
                        return {};\n
                    }\n
                };\n
\n
                const elementLabel = element => {\n
                    if (element.dataset.signalLabel) {\n
                        return element.dataset.signalLabel;\n
                    }\n
\n
                    if (element.getAttribute('aria-label')) {\n
                        return element.getAttribute('aria-label');\n
                    }\n
\n
                    if (element.getAttribute('title')) {\n
                        return element.getAttribute('title');\n
                    }\n
\n
                    return element.textContent?.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim().slice(0, 120) || null;\n
                };\n
\n
                const inputValue = (target, trigger) => {\n
                    const includeValue = target.dataset.signalIncludeValue === 'true'\n
                        || trigger?.dataset.signalIncludeValue === 'true';\n
\n
                    if (! includeValue) {\n
                        return null;\n
                    }\n
\n
                    if (['password', 'email', 'tel'].includes(target.type)) {\n
                        return null;\n
                    }\n
\n
                    if (target.type === 'checkbox') {\n
                        return target.checked;\n
                    }\n
\n
                    if (target.type === 'radio') {\n
                        return target.checked ? target.value : null;\n
                    }\n
\n
                    return target.value || null;\n
                };\n
\n
                const browserPlatform = () => {\n
                    const userAgent = navigator.userAgent.toLowerCase();\n
\n
                    if (userAgent.includes('ipad')) {\n
                        return 'ipados';\n
                    }\n
\n
                    if (userAgent.includes('iphone') || userAgent.includes('ipod')) {\n
                        return 'ios';\n
                    }\n
\n
                    if (userAgent.includes('android')) {\n
                        return 'android';\n
                    }\n
\n
                    if (userAgent.includes('macintosh') || userAgent.includes('mac os')) {\n
                        return 'macos';\n
                    }\n
\n
                    if (userAgent.includes('windows')) {\n
                        return 'windows';\n
                    }\n
\n
                    if (userAgent.includes('linux')) {\n
                        return 'linux';\n
                    }\n
\n
                    return 'web';\n
                };\n
\n
                const browserFamily = platform => {\n
                    if (['ios', 'android', 'ipados'].includes(platform)) {\n
                        return 'mobile';\n
                    }\n
\n
                    if (['macos', 'windows', 'linux'].includes(platform)) {\n
                        return 'desktop';\n
                    }\n
\n
                    return 'web';\n
                };\n
\n
                const baseProperties = (trigger, sourceElement = trigger) => {\n
                    const target = sourceElement instanceof HTMLElement ? sourceElement : trigger;\n
                    const platform = browserPlatform();\n
\n
                    return {\n
                        ...parseProperties(trigger.dataset.signalProps),\n
                        surface: activeConfig()?.surface || 'public',\n
                        page: window.location.pathname,\n
                        client_origin: 'web',\n
                        client_origin_source: 'browser_tracker',\n
                        client_platform: platform,\n
                        client_family: browserFamily(platform),\n
                        client_transport: 'web',\n
                        component: trigger.dataset.signalComponent || trigger.closest('[data-signal-component]')?.dataset.signalComponent || null,\n
                        control: trigger.dataset.signalControl || target?.name || target?.id || null,\n
                        label: elementLabel(trigger),\n
                        entity_type: trigger.dataset.signalEntityType || null,\n
                        entity_id: trigger.dataset.signalEntityId || null,\n
                        href: trigger instanceof HTMLAnchorElement ? trigger.href : null,\n
                    };\n
                };\n
\n
                const trackingPayload = (eventName, properties = {}, eventCategory = null) => {\n
                    const config = activeConfig();\n
                    const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);\n
\n
                    if (! config?.eventEndpoint || ! config.writeKey) {\n
                        return null;\n
                    }\n
\n
                    return {\n
                        endpoint: config.eventEndpoint,\n
                        body: {\n
                            write_key: config.writeKey,\n
                            event_name: eventName,\n
                            event_category: eventCategory || eventName.split('.')[0] || 'ui',\n
                            external_id: config.externalId || null,\n
                            anonymous_id: anonymousIdentifier(config),\n
                            session_identifier: sessionIdentifier(config),\n
                            session_started_at: sessionStartedAt(config),\n
                            occurred_at: new Date().toISOString(),\n
                            path: window.location.pathname + window.location.search + window.location.hash,\n
                            url: window.location.href,\n
                            referrer: document.referrer || null,\n
                            utm_source: params.get('utm_source'),\n
                            utm_medium: params.get('utm_medium'),\n
                            utm_campaign: params.get('utm_campaign'),\n
                            utm_content: params.get('utm_content'),\n
                            utm_term: params.get('utm_term'),\n
                            properties,\n
                        },\n
                    };\n
                };\n
\n
                window.ilmu360.trackSignal = (eventName, properties = {}, options = {}) => {\n
                    if (! eventName) {\n
                        return;\n
                    }\n
\n
                    const payload = trackingPayload(eventName, properties, options.category || null);\n
\n
                    if (! payload) {\n
                        return;\n
                    }\n
\n
                    const body = JSON.stringify(payload.body);\n
\n
                    if (navigator.sendBeacon) {\n

                        return;\n
                    }\n

                    fetch(payload.endpoint, {\n
                        method: 'POST',\n
                        headers: {\n
                            'Content-Type': 'application/json',\n
                        },\n
                        body,\n
                        keepalive: true,\n
                        credentials: 'omit',\n
                    }).catch(() => {});\n
                };\n
\n
                document.addEventListener('click', event => {\n
                    const trigger = event.target instanceof Element ? event.target.closest('[data-signal-event]') : null;\n
\n
                    if (! trigger || trigger.matches('[disabled], [aria-disabled="true"]')) {\n
                        return;\n
                    }\n
\n
                    window.ilmu360.trackSignal(\n
                        trigger.dataset.signalEvent,\n
                        baseProperties(trigger),\n
                        { category: trigger.dataset.signalCategory || null },\n
                    );\n
                }, true);\n
\n
                document.addEventListener('submit', event => {\n
                    const form = event.target instanceof HTMLFormElement ? event.target : null;\n
\n
                    if (! form?.dataset.signalSubmitEvent) {\n
                        return;\n
                    }\n
\n
                    window.ilmu360.trackSignal(\n
                        form.dataset.signalSubmitEvent,\n
                        baseProperties(form),\n
                        { category: form.dataset.signalCategory || null },\n
                    );\n
                }, true);\n
\n
                document.addEventListener('change', event => {\n
                    const target = event.target instanceof HTMLElement ? event.target : null;\n
                    const trigger = target?.closest('[data-signal-change-event]');\n
\n
                    if (! target || ! trigger) {\n
                        return;\n
                    }\n
\n
                    window.ilmu360.trackSignal(\n
                        trigger.dataset.signalChangeEvent,\n
                        {\n
                            ...baseProperties(trigger, target),\n
                            field_name: target.getAttribute('name') || target.id || null,\n
                            field_type: target.getAttribute('type') || target.tagName.toLowerCase(),\n
                            field_value: inputValue(target, trigger),\n
                        },\n
                        { category: trigger.dataset.signalCategory || null },\n
                    );\n
                }, true);\n
            })();\n

            cookieName: 'public_geolocation_permission',\n
        }),\n
        locating: false,\n
        locationNotice: null,\n
        copiedShareLink: false,\n
        copiedEventId: null,\n
        shareData: null,\n
        trackEndpoint: 'https:\/\/ilmu360.test\/kongsi\/track',\n
        providerQueryParameter: 'channel',\n
        attributedShareData: null,\n
        setLocationNotice(message) {\n
            this.locationNotice = message;\n
        },\n
        clearLocationNotice() {\n
            this.locationNotice = null;\n
        },\n
        async locate() {\n
            if (this.locating) return;\n
            this.clearLocationNotice();\n
            if (! navigator.geolocation) {\n
                this.setGeolocationPermission(false);\n
                this.setLocationNotice('Geolokasi tidak disokong oleh pelayar anda.');\n
                return;\n
            }\n
\n
            if (navigator.permissions && typeof navigator.permissions.query === 'function') {\n
                try {\n
                    const permissionStatus = await navigator.permissions.query({ name: 'geolocation' });\n
\n
                    if (permissionStatus.state === 'denied') {\n
                        this.setGeolocationPermission(false);\n
                    }\n
                } catch (error) {\n
                }\n
            }\n
\n
            this.locating = true;\n
            navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition((position) => {\n
                this.clearLocationNotice();\n
                this.setGeolocationPermission(true);\n
                this.$wire.setLocation(position.coords.latitude, position.coords.longitude);\n
                this.locating = false;\n
            }, (error) => {\n
                this.locating = false;\n
                if (error?.code === 1) {\n
                    this.setGeolocationPermission(false);\n
                    this.setLocationNotice('Benarkan akses lokasi dalam tetapan pelayar anda untuk menggunakan carian berhampiran.');\n
\n
                    return;\n
                }\n
\n
                this.setLocationNotice('Tidak dapat mendapatkan lokasi anda. Sila aktifkan perkhidmatan lokasi.');\n
            });\n
        },\n
        async resolveShareData() {\n
            if (! this.shareData) {\n
                return null;\n
            }\n
\n
            if (this.attributedShareData) {\n
                return this.attributedShareData;\n
            }\n
\n
            const params = new URLSearchParams({\n
                url: this.shareData.sourceUrl,\n
                text: this.shareData.shareText,\n
                title: this.shareData.fallbackTitle,\n
            });\n
            const response = await fetch(`${this.shareData.payloadEndpoint}?${params.toString()}`, {\n
                headers: {\n
                    Accept: 'application/json',\n
                },\n
            });\n
\n
            if (! response.ok) {\n
                return this.shareData;\n
            }\n
\n
            const payload = await response.json();\n
            this.attributedShareData = {\n
                ...this.shareData,\n
                url: payload.url,\n
                tracking_token: payload.tracking_token ?? null,\n
            };\n
\n
            return this.attributedShareData;\n
        },\n
        async sharePayloadForChannel(provider = null) {\n
            const shareData = await this.resolveShareData();\n
\n
            if (! shareData || ! provider || ! shareData.tracking_token) {\n
                return shareData;\n
            }\n
\n
            try {\n
                const shareUrl = new URL(shareData.url, window.location.origin);\n
                shareUrl.searchParams.set(this.providerQueryParameter, provider);\n
\n
                return {\n
                    ...shareData,\n
                    url: shareUrl.toString(),\n
                };\n
            } catch (error) {\n

            }\n
        },\n
        async trackShare(provider) {\n
            const shareData = await this.resolveShareData();\n
\n
            if (! shareData?.tracking_token) {\n
                return;\n
            }\n
\n
            const csrfToken = document.querySelector('meta[name=csrf-token]')?.content;\n
\n
            if (! csrfToken) {\n

                    Accept: 'application/json',\n

            });\n

        async shareResults() {\n

            <style>\n

            width: 100%;\n

\n

</style>\n
\n
<div\n
    id="app-toast-stack"\n
    data-toast-root\n
    x-data="{\n
        toasts: [],\n
        push(detail = {}) {\n
            if (!detail.message) {\n
                return;\n
            }\n
\n
            const toast = {\n
                id: detail.id ?? `${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(16).slice(2)}`,\n
                type: detail.type ?? 'success',\n
                title: detail.title ?? null,\n
                message: detail.message,\n
                timeout: Number(detail.timeout ?? (detail.type === 'error' ? 5200 : 4200)),\n
            };\n
\n
            this.toasts = [...this.toasts, toast];\n
            this.scheduleRemoval(toast.id, toast.timeout);\n
        },\n
        remove(id) {\n
            this.toasts = this.toasts.filter((toast) => toast.id !== id);\n
        },\n
        scheduleRemoval(id, timeout) {\n
            if (!timeout || timeout < 1) {\n
                return;\n
            }\n
\n
            window.setTimeout(() => this.remove(id), timeout);\n
        },\n
        init() {\n
            this.toasts.forEach((toast) => this.scheduleRemoval(toast.id, toast.timeout));\n
        },\n
    }"\n
    x-on:app-toast.window="push($event.detail ?? {})"\n
    class="pointer-events-none fixed inset-x-0 top-4 z-[100] flex justify-center px-4 sm:justify-end sm:px-6"\n
>\n
    <div class="flex w-full max-w-sm flex-col gap-3 sm:max-w-md">\n
        <template x-for="toast in toasts" :key="toast.id">\n
            <div\n
                x-cloak\n
                x-transition:enter="transform ease-out duration-300"\n
                x-transition:enter-start="translate-y-3 opacity-0 sm:translate-x-8 sm:translate-y-0"\n
                x-transition:enter-end="translate-y-0 opacity-100 sm:translate-x-0"\n
                x-transition:leave="transform ease-in duration-200"\n
                x-transition:leave-start="translate-y-0 opacity-100"\n
                x-transition:leave-end="-translate-y-2 opacity-0"\n
                class="pointer-events-auto overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border shadow-2xl backdrop-blur-xl"\n
                :class="toast.type === 'error'\n
                    ? 'border-rose-200 bg-white/95 shadow-rose-500/10'\n
                    : toast.type === 'warning'\n
                        ? 'border-amber-200 bg-white/95 shadow-amber-500/10'\n
                        : 'border-emerald-200 bg-white/95 shadow-emerald-500/10'"\n
            >\n
                <div class="flex items-start gap-3 p-4">\n
                    <div class="mt-0.5 flex h-10 w-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl"\n
                        :class="toast.type === 'error'\n
                            ? 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-600'\n
                            : toast.type === 'warning'\n
                                ? 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-600'\n
                                : 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-600'">\n
                        <svg x-show="toast.type !== 'error' && toast.type !== 'warning'" class="h-5 w-5" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">\n
                            <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M5 13l4 4L19 7" />\n
                        </svg>\n
                        <svg x-show="toast.type === 'warning'" class="h-5 w-5" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">\n
                            <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M12 9v2m0 4h.01M10.29 3.86l-7.55 13.09A1 1 0 003.61 18h16.78a1 1 0 00.87-1.5L13.71 3.86a1 1 0 00-1.74 0z" />\n

        <script>\n
        (() => {\n
            const timezone = Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone;\n
\n
            if (!timezone) {\n
                return;\n
            }\n
\n
            document.cookie = `user_timezone=${encodeURIComponent(timezone)}; path=/; max-age=31536000; SameSite=Lax`;\n
        })();\n
\n
        window.ilmu360 = window.ilmu360 || {};\n
        window.ilmu360.geolocationPermission = ({\n
            initiallyGranted = false,\n
            cookieName = 'public_geolocation_permission',\n
        } = {}) => ({\n
            geolocationPermitted: Boolean(initiallyGranted),\n
            geolocationPermissionCookieName: cookieName,\n
            init() {\n
                this.syncGeolocationPermission();\n
            },\n
            persistGeolocationPermission(granted) {\n
                document.cookie = `${this.geolocationPermissionCookieName}=${granted ? '1' : '0'}; path=/; max-age=31536000; SameSite=Lax`;\n
            },\n
            setGeolocationPermission(granted) {\n
                this.geolocationPermitted = Boolean(granted);\n
                this.persistGeolocationPermission(this.geolocationPermitted);\n
            },\n
            async syncGeolocationPermission() {\n
                if (!('geolocation' in navigator)) {\n
                    this.setGeolocationPermission(false);\n
\n
                    return;\n
                }\n
\n
                if (!navigator.permissions || typeof navigator.permissions.query !== 'function') {\n
                    return;\n
                }\n
\n
                try {\n
                    const permissionStatus = await navigator.permissions.query({ name: 'geolocation' });\n
                    const applyPermission = () => this.setGeolocationPermission(permissionStatus.state === 'granted');\n
\n
                    applyPermission();\n
\n
                    if (typeof permissionStatus.addEventListener === 'function') {\n
                        permissionStatus.addEventListener('change', applyPermission);\n
\n
                        return;\n
                    }\n
\n
                    permissionStatus.onchange = applyPermission;\n
                } catch (error) {\n
                    this.setGeolocationPermission(false);\n
                }\n
            },\n
        });\n
    </script>\n

            <script>\n
            (() => {\n
                window.ilmu360 = window.ilmu360 || {};\n
\n
                if (window.ilmu360.signalsUiInitialized) {\n
                    return;\n
                }\n
\n
                window.ilmu360.signalsUiInitialized = true;\n
\n
                const storageValue = (storage, key) => {\n
                    try {\n
                        return storage.getItem(key);\n
                    } catch (error) {\n
                        return null;\n
                    }\n
                };\n
\n
                const persistStorageValue = (storage, key, value) => {\n
                    try {\n
                        storage.setItem(key, value);\n
                    } catch (error) {\n
                    }\n
                };\n
\n
                const readCookie = name => {\n
                    const prefix = `${name}=`;\n
                    const cookies = document.cookie ? document.cookie.split(';') : [];\n
\n
                    for (const cookiePart of cookies) {\n
                        const cookie = cookiePart.trim();\n
\n
                        if (cookie.startsWith(prefix)) {\n
                            return decodeURIComponent(cookie.slice(prefix.length));\n
                        }\n
                    }\n
\n
                    return null;\n
                };\n
\n
                const writeCookie = (name, value, maxAgeSeconds = null) => {\n
                    let cookie = `${name}=${encodeURIComponent(value)}; path=/; SameSite=Lax`;\n
\n
                    if (typeof maxAgeSeconds === 'number') {\n
                        cookie += `; Max-Age=${maxAgeSeconds}`;\n
                    }\n
\n
                    if (window.location.protocol === 'https:') {\n
                        cookie += '; Secure';\n
                    }\n
\n
                    document.cookie = cookie;\n
                };\n
\n
                const activeConfig = () => {\n
                    const configured = window.ilmu360.signals || {};\n
\n
                    if (configured.writeKey && configured.eventEndpoint) {\n
                        return configured;\n
                    }\n
\n
                    const script = document.querySelector('script[data-signals-tracker][data-write-key]');\n
\n
                    if (! script) {\n
                        return null;\n
                    }\n
\n
                    return {\n
                        surface: script.dataset.surface || 'public',\n
                        eventEndpoint: script.dataset.eventEndpoint,\n
                        anonymousCookieName: script.dataset.anonymousCookieName || 'mi_signals_anonymous_id',\n
                        sessionCookieName: script.dataset.sessionCookieName || 'mi_signals_session_id',\n
                        writeKey: script.dataset.writeKey,\n
                        externalId: script.dataset.externalId || null,\n
                        email: script.dataset.email || null,\n
                    };\n
                };\n
\n
                const anonymousIdentifier = config => {\n
                    const storageKey = `signals:anonymous:${config.writeKey}`;\n
                    const existing = storageValue(localStorage, storageKey) || readCookie(config.anonymousCookieName);\n
\n
                    if (existing) {\n
                        persistStorageValue(localStorage, storageKey, existing);\n
                        writeCookie(config.anonymousCookieName, existing, 31536000);\n
\n
                        return existing;\n
                    }\n
\n
                    const created = `sig_anon_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)}${Date.now().toString(36)}`;\n
\n
                    persistStorageValue(localStorage, storageKey, created);\n
                    writeCookie(config.anonymousCookieName, created, 31536000);\n
\n
                    return created;\n
                };\n
\n
                const sessionIdentifier = config => {\n
                    const storageKey = `signals:session:${config.writeKey}`;\n
                    const existing = storageValue(sessionStorage, storageKey);\n
\n
                    if (existing) {\n
                        writeCookie(config.sessionCookieName, existing);\n
\n
                        return existing;\n
                    }\n
\n
                    const created = `sig_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)}${Date.now().toString(36)}`;\n
\n
                    persistStorageValue(sessionStorage, storageKey, created);\n
                    persistStorageValue(sessionStorage, `signals:session-started-at:${config.writeKey}`, new Date().toISOString());\n
                    writeCookie(config.sessionCookieName, created);\n
\n
                    return created;\n
                };\n
\n
                const sessionStartedAt = config => {\n
                    const storageKey = `signals:session-started-at:${config.writeKey}`;\n
                    const existing = storageValue(sessionStorage, storageKey);\n
\n
                    if (existing) {\n
                        return existing;\n
                    }\n
\n
                    const created = new Date().toISOString();\n
\n
                    persistStorageValue(sessionStorage, storageKey, created);\n
\n
                    return created;\n
                };\n
\n
                const parseProperties = value => {\n
                    if (! value) {\n
                        return {};\n
                    }\n
\n
                    try {\n
                        const parsed = JSON.parse(value);\n
\n
                        return parsed && typeof parsed === 'object' && ! Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed : {};\n
                    } catch (error) {\n
                        return {};\n
                    }\n
                };\n
\n
                const elementLabel = element => {\n
                    if (element.dataset.signalLabel) {\n
                        return element.dataset.signalLabel;\n
                    }\n
\n
                    if (element.getAttribute('aria-label')) {\n
                        return element.getAttribute('aria-label');\n
                    }\n
\n
                    if (element.getAttribute('title')) {\n
                        return element.getAttribute('title');\n
                    }\n
\n
                    return element.textContent?.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim().slice(0, 120) || null;\n
                };\n
\n
                const inputValue = (target, trigger) => {\n
                    const includeValue = target.dataset.signalIncludeValue === 'true'\n
                        || trigger?.dataset.signalIncludeValue === 'true';\n
\n
                    if (! includeValue) {\n
                        return null;\n
                    }\n
\n
                    if (['password', 'email', 'tel'].includes(target.type)) {\n
                        return null;\n
                    }\n
\n
                    if (target.type === 'checkbox') {\n
                        return target.checked;\n
                    }\n
\n
                    if (target.type === 'radio') {\n
                        return target.checked ? target.value : null;\n
                    }\n
\n
                    return target.value || null;\n
                };\n
\n
                const browserPlatform = () => {\n
                    const userAgent = navigator.userAgent.toLowerCase();\n
\n
                    if (userAgent.includes('ipad')) {\n
                        return 'ipados';\n
                    }\n
\n
                    if (userAgent.includes('iphone') || userAgent.includes('ipod')) {\n
                        return 'ios';\n
                    }\n
\n
                    if (userAgent.includes('android')) {\n
                        return 'android';\n
                    }\n
\n
                    if (userAgent.includes('macintosh') || userAgent.includes('mac os')) {\n
                        return 'macos';\n
                    }\n
\n
                    if (userAgent.includes('windows')) {\n
                        return 'windows';\n
                    }\n
\n
                    if (userAgent.includes('linux')) {\n
                        return 'linux';\n
                    }\n
\n
                    return 'web';\n
                };\n
\n
                const browserFamily = platform => {\n
                    if (['ios', 'android', 'ipados'].includes(platform)) {\n
                        return 'mobile';\n
                    }\n
\n
                    if (['macos', 'windows', 'linux'].includes(platform)) {\n
                        return 'desktop';\n
                    }\n
\n
                    return 'web';\n
                };\n
\n
                const baseProperties = (trigger, sourceElement = trigger) => {\n
                    const target = sourceElement instanceof HTMLElement ? sourceElement : trigger;\n
                    const platform = browserPlatform();\n
\n
                    return {\n
                        ...parseProperties(trigger.dataset.signalProps),\n
                        surface: activeConfig()?.surface || 'public',\n
                        page: window.location.pathname,\n
                        client_origin: 'web',\n
                        client_origin_source: 'browser_tracker',\n
                        client_platform: platform,\n
                        client_family: browserFamily(platform),\n
                        client_transport: 'web',\n
                        component: trigger.dataset.signalComponent || trigger.closest('[data-signal-component]')?.dataset.signalComponent || null,\n
                        control: trigger.dataset.signalControl || target?.name || target?.id || null,\n
                        label: elementLabel(trigger),\n
                        entity_type: trigger.dataset.signalEntityType || null,\n
                        entity_id: trigger.dataset.signalEntityId || null,\n
                        href: trigger instanceof HTMLAnchorElement ? trigger.href : null,\n
                    };\n
                };\n
\n
                const trackingPayload = (eventName, properties = {}, eventCategory = null) => {\n
                    const config = activeConfig();\n
                    const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);\n
\n
                    if (! config?.eventEndpoint || ! config.writeKey) {\n
                        return null;\n
                    }\n
\n
                    return {\n
                        endpoint: config.eventEndpoint,\n
                        body: {\n
                            write_key: config.writeKey,\n
                            event_name: eventName,\n
                            event_category: eventCategory || eventName.split('.')[0] || 'ui',\n
                            external_id: config.externalId || null,\n
                            anonymous_id: anonymousIdentifier(config),\n
                            session_identifier: sessionIdentifier(config),\n
                            session_started_at: sessionStartedAt(config),\n
                            occurred_at: new Date().toISOString(),\n
                            path: window.location.pathname + window.location.search + window.location.hash,\n
                            url: window.location.href,\n
                            referrer: document.referrer || null,\n
                            utm_source: params.get('utm_source'),\n
                            utm_medium: params.get('utm_medium'),\n
                            utm_campaign: params.get('utm_campaign'),\n
                            utm_content: params.get('utm_content'),\n
                            utm_term: params.get('utm_term'),\n
                            properties,\n
                        },\n
                    };\n
                };\n
\n
                window.ilmu360.trackSignal = (eventName, properties = {}, options = {}) => {\n
                    if (! eventName) {\n
                        return;\n
                    }\n
\n
                    const payload = trackingPayload(eventName, properties, options.category || null);\n
\n
                    if (! payload) {\n
                        return;\n
                    }\n
\n
                    const body = JSON.stringify(payload.body);\n
\n
                    if (navigator.sendBeacon) {\n
                        navigator.sendBeacon(payload.endpoint, new Blob([body], { type: 'application/json' }));\n
\n
                        return;\n
                    }\n
\n
                    fetch(payload.endpoint, {\n
                        method: 'POST',\n
                        headers: {\n
                            'Content-Type': 'application/json',\n
                        },\n
                        body,\n
                        keepalive: true,\n
                        credentials: 'omit',\n
                    }).catch(() => {});\n
                };\n
\n
                document.addEventListener('click', event => {\n
                    const trigger = event.target instanceof Element ? event.target.closest('[data-signal-event]') : null;\n
\n
                    if (! trigger || trigger.matches('[disabled], [aria-disabled="true"]')) {\n
                        return;\n
                    }\n
\n
                    window.ilmu360.trackSignal(\n
                        trigger.dataset.signalEvent,\n
                        baseProperties(trigger),\n
                        { category: trigger.dataset.signalCategory || null },\n
                    );\n
                }, true);\n
\n
                document.addEventListener('submit', event => {\n
                    const form = event.target instanceof HTMLFormElement ? event.target : null;\n
\n
                    if (! form?.dataset.signalSubmitEvent) {\n
                        return;\n
                    }\n
\n
                    window.ilmu360.trackSignal(\n
                        form.dataset.signalSubmitEvent,\n
                        baseProperties(form),\n
                        { category: form.dataset.signalCategory || null },\n
                    );\n
                }, true);\n
\n
                document.addEventListener('change', event => {\n
                    const target = event.target instanceof HTMLElement ? event.target : null;\n
                    const trigger = target?.closest('[data-signal-change-event]');\n
\n
                    if (! target || ! trigger) {\n
                        return;\n
                    }\n
\n
                    window.ilmu360.trackSignal(\n
                        trigger.dataset.signalChangeEvent,\n
                        {\n
                            ...baseProperties(trigger, target),\n
                            field_name: target.getAttribute('name') || target.id || null,\n
                            field_type: target.getAttribute('type') || target.tagName.toLowerCase(),\n
                            field_value: inputValue(target, trigger),\n
                        },\n
                        { category: trigger.dataset.signalCategory || null },\n
                    );\n
                }, true);\n
            })();\n
        </script>\n

        window.ilmu360 = window.ilmu360 || {};\n
        window.ilmu360.signals = {\n
            surface: 'public',\n
            endpoint: 'https:\/\/ilmu360.test\/api\/signals\/collect\/pageview',\n
            eventEndpoint: 'https:\/\/ilmu360.test\/api\/signals\/collect\/event',\n
            identifyEndpoint: 'https:\/\/ilmu360.test\/api\/signals\/collect\/identify',\n
            anonymousCookieName: 'mi_signals_anonymous_id',\n
            sessionCookieName: 'mi_signals_session_id',\n
            writeKey: 'ClUtfpFgSSBJXXtbqM5NNHEFuLju5Sa98kqPucTp',\n
            externalId: null,\n
            email: null,\n
        };\n

\n
    <script\n
        defer\n
        data-signals-tracker\n
        src="https://ilmu360.test/api/signals/tracker.js"\n
        data-endpoint="https://ilmu360.test/api/signals/collect/pageview"\n
        data-event-endpoint="https://ilmu360.test/api/signals/collect/event"\n
        data-identify-endpoint="https://ilmu360.test/api/signals/collect/identify"\n
        data-anonymous-cookie-name="mi_signals_anonymous_id"\n
        data-session-cookie-name="mi_signals_session_id"\n
        data-write-key="ClUtfpFgSSBJXXtbqM5NNHEFuLju5Sa98kqPucTp"\n
        data-surface="public"\n
                data-enable-geolocation="true"></script>\n
\n
            <script>\n
            (() => {\n
                window.ilmu360 = window.ilmu360 || {};\n
\n
                if (window.ilmu360.signalsUiInitialized) {\n
                    return;\n
                }\n
\n
                window.ilmu360.signalsUiInitialized = true;\n
\n
                const storageValue = (storage, key) => {\n
                    try {\n
                        return storage.getItem(key);\n
                    } catch (error) {\n
                        return null;\n
                    }\n
                };\n
\n
                const persistStorageValue = (storage, key, value) => {\n
                    try {\n
                        storage.setItem(key, value);\n
                    } catch (error) {\n
                    }\n
                };\n
\n
                const readCookie = name => {\n
                    const prefix = `${name}=`;\n
                    const cookies = document.cookie ? document.cookie.split(';') : [];\n
\n
                    for (const cookiePart of cookies) {\n
                        const cookie = cookiePart.trim();\n
\n
                        if (cookie.startsWith(prefix)) {\n
                            return decodeURIComponent(cookie.slice(prefix.length));\n
                        }\n
                    }\n
\n
                    return null;\n
                };\n
\n
                const writeCookie = (name, value, maxAgeSeconds = null) => {\n
                    let cookie = `${name}=${encodeURIComponent(value)}; path=/; SameSite=Lax`;\n
\n
                    if (typeof maxAgeSeconds === 'number') {\n
                        cookie += `; Max-Age=${maxAgeSeconds}`;\n
                    }\n
\n
                    if (window.location.protocol === 'https:') {\n
                        cookie += '; Secure';\n
                    }\n
\n
                    document.cookie = cookie;\n
                };\n
\n
                const activeConfig = () => {\n
                    const configured = window.ilmu360.signals || {};\n
\n
                    if (configured.writeKey && configured.eventEndpoint) {\n
                        return configured;\n
                    }\n
\n
                    const script = document.querySelector('script[data-signals-tracker][data-write-key]');\n
\n
                    if (! script) {\n
                        return null;\n
                    }\n
\n
                    return {\n
                        surface: script.dataset.surface || 'public',\n
                        eventEndpoint: script.dataset.eventEndpoint,\n
                        anonymousCookieName: script.dataset.anonymousCookieName || 'mi_signals_anonymous_id',\n
                        sessionCookieName: script.dataset.sessionCookieName || 'mi_signals_session_id',\n
                        writeKey: script.dataset.writeKey,\n
                        externalId: script.dataset.externalId || null,\n
                        email: script.dataset.email || null,\n
                    };\n
                };\n
\n
                const anonymousIdentifier = config => {\n
                    const storageKey = `signals:anonymous:${config.writeKey}`;\n
                    const existing = storageValue(localStorage, storageKey) || readCookie(config.anonymousCookieName);\n
\n
                    if (existing) {\n
                        persistStorageValue(localStorage, storageKey, existing);\n
                        writeCookie(config.anonymousCookieName, existing, 31536000);\n
\n
                        return existing;\n
                    }\n
\n
                    const created = `sig_anon_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)}${Date.now().toString(36)}`;\n
\n
                    persistStorageValue(localStorage, storageKey, created);\n
                    writeCookie(config.anonymousCookieName, created, 31536000);\n
\n
                    return created;\n
                };\n
\n
                const sessionIdentifier = config => {\n
                    const storageKey = `signals:session:${config.writeKey}`;\n
                    const existing = storageValue(sessionStorage, storageKey);\n
\n
                    if (existing) {\n
                        writeCookie(config.sessionCookieName, existing);\n
\n
                        return existing;\n
                    }\n
\n
                    const created = `sig_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)}${Date.now().toString(36)}`;\n
\n
                    persistStorageValue(sessionStorage, storageKey, created);\n
                    persistStorageValue(sessionStorage, `signals:session-started-at:${config.writeKey}`, new Date().toISOString());\n
                    writeCookie(config.sessionCookieName, created);\n
\n
                    return created;\n
                };\n
\n
                const sessionStartedAt = config => {\n
                    const storageKey = `signals:session-started-at:${config.writeKey}`;\n
                    const existing = storageValue(sessionStorage, storageKey);\n
\n
                    if (existing) {\n
                        return existing;\n
                    }\n
\n
                    const created = new Date().toISOString();\n
\n
                    persistStorageValue(sessionStorage, storageKey, created);\n
\n
                    return created;\n
                };\n
\n
                const parseProperties = value => {\n
                    if (! value) {\n
                        return {};\n
                    }\n
\n
                    try {\n
                        const parsed = JSON.parse(value);\n
\n
                        return parsed && typeof parsed === 'object' && ! Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed : {};\n
                    } catch (error) {\n
                        return {};\n
                    }\n
                };\n
\n
                const elementLabel = element => {\n
                    if (element.dataset.signalLabel) {\n
                        return element.dataset.signalLabel;\n
                    }\n
\n
                    if (element.getAttribute('aria-label')) {\n
                        return element.getAttribute('aria-label');\n
                    }\n
\n
                    if (element.getAttribute('title')) {\n
                        return element.getAttribute('title');\n
                    }\n
\n
                    return element.textContent?.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim().slice(0, 120) || null;\n
                };\n
\n
                const inputValue = (target, trigger) => {\n
                    const includeValue = target.dataset.signalIncludeValue === 'true'\n
                        || trigger?.dataset.signalIncludeValue === 'true';\n
\n
                    if (! includeValue) {\n
                        return null;\n
                    }\n
\n
                    if (['password', 'email', 'tel'].includes(target.type)) {\n
                        return null;\n
                    }\n
\n
                    if (target.type === 'checkbox') {\n
                        return target.checked;\n
                    }\n
\n
                    if (target.type === 'radio') {\n
                        return target.checked ? target.value : null;\n
                    }\n
\n
                    return target.value || null;\n
                };\n
\n
                const browserPlatform = () => {\n
                    const userAgent = navigator.userAgent.toLowerCase();\n
\n
                    if (userAgent.includes('ipad')) {\n
                        return 'ipados';\n
                    }\n
\n
                    if (userAgent.includes('iphone') || userAgent.includes('ipod')) {\n
                        return 'ios';\n
                    }\n
\n
                    if (userAgent.includes('android')) {\n
                        return 'android';\n
                    }\n
\n
                    if (userAgent.includes('macintosh') || userAgent.includes('mac os')) {\n
                        return 'macos';\n
                    }\n
\n
                    if (userAgent.includes('windows')) {\n
                        return 'windows';\n
                    }\n
\n
                    if (userAgent.includes('linux')) {\n
                        return 'linux';\n
                    }\n
\n
                    return 'web';\n
                };\n
\n
                const browserFamily = platform => {\n
                    if (['ios', 'android', 'ipados'].includes(platform)) {\n
                        return 'mobile';\n
                    }\n
\n
                    if (['macos', 'windows', 'linux'].includes(platform)) {\n
                        return 'desktop';\n
                    }\n
\n
                    return 'web';\n
                };\n
\n
                const baseProperties = (trigger, sourceElement = trigger) => {\n
                    const target = sourceElement instanceof HTMLElement ? sourceElement : trigger;\n
                    const platform = browserPlatform();\n
\n
                    return {\n
                        ...parseProperties(trigger.dataset.signalProps),\n
                        surface: activeConfig()?.surface || 'public',\n
                        page: window.location.pathname,\n
                        client_origin: 'web',\n
                        client_origin_source: 'browser_tracker',\n
                        client_platform: platform,\n
                        client_family: browserFamily(platform),\n
                        client_transport: 'web',\n
                        component: trigger.dataset.signalComponent || trigger.closest('[data-signal-component]')?.dataset.signalComponent || null,\n
                        control: trigger.dataset.signalControl || target?.name || target?.id || null,\n
                        label: elementLabel(trigger),\n
                        entity_type: trigger.dataset.signalEntityType || null,\n
                        entity_id: trigger.dataset.signalEntityId || null,\n
                        href: trigger instanceof HTMLAnchorElement ? trigger.href : null,\n
                    };\n
                };\n
\n
                const trackingPayload = (eventName, properties = {}, eventCategory = null) => {\n
                    const config = activeConfig();\n
                    const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);\n
\n
                    if (! config?.eventEndpoint || ! config.writeKey) {\n
                        return null;\n
                    }\n
\n
                    return {\n
                        endpoint: config.eventEndpoint,\n
                        body: {\n
                            write_key: config.writeKey,\n
                            event_name: eventName,\n
                            event_category: eventCategory || eventName.split('.')[0] || 'ui',\n
                            external_id: config.externalId || null,\n
                            anonymous_id: anonymousIdentifier(config),\n
                            session_identifier: sessionIdentifier(config),\n
                            session_started_at: sessionStartedAt(config),\n
                            occurred_at: new Date().toISOString(),\n
                            path: window.location.pathname + window.location.search + window.location.hash,\n
                            url: window.location.href,\n
                            referrer: document.referrer || null,\n
                            utm_source: params.get('utm_source'),\n
                            utm_medium: params.get('utm_medium'),\n
                            utm_campaign: params.get('utm_campaign'),\n
                            utm_content: params.get('utm_content'),\n
                            utm_term: params.get('utm_term'),\n
                            properties,\n
                        },\n
                    };\n
                };\n
\n
                window.ilmu360.trackSignal = (eventName, properties = {}, options = {}) => {\n
                    if (! eventName) {\n
                        return;\n
                    }\n
\n
                    const payload = trackingPayload(eventName, properties, options.category || null);\n
\n
                    if (! payload) {\n
                        return;\n
                    }\n
\n
                    const body = JSON.stringify(payload.body);\n
\n
                    if (navigator.sendBeacon) {\n
                        navigator.sendBeacon(payload.endpoint, new Blob([body], { type: 'application/json' }));\n
\n
                        return;\n
                    }\n
\n
                    fetch(payload.endpoint, {\n
                        method: 'POST',\n
                        headers: {\n
                            'Content-Type': 'application/json',\n
                        },\n
                        body,\n
                        keepalive: true,\n
                        credentials: 'omit',\n
                    }).catch(() => {});\n
                };\n
\n
                document.addEventListener('click', event => {\n
                    const trigger = event.target instanceof Element ? event.target.closest('[data-signal-event]') : null;\n
\n
                    if (! trigger || trigger.matches('[disabled], [aria-disabled="true"]')) {\n
                        return;\n
                    }\n
\n
                    window.ilmu360.trackSignal(\n
                        trigger.dataset.signalEvent,\n
                        baseProperties(trigger),\n
                        { category: trigger.dataset.signalCategory || null },\n
                    );\n
                }, true);\n
\n
                document.addEventListener('submit', event => {\n
                    const form = event.target instanceof HTMLFormElement ? event.target : null;\n
\n
                    if (! form?.dataset.signalSubmitEvent) {\n
                        return;\n
                    }\n
\n
                    window.ilmu360.trackSignal(\n
                        form.dataset.signalSubmitEvent,\n
                        baseProperties(form),\n
                        { category: form.dataset.signalCategory || null },\n
                    );\n
                }, true);\n
\n
                document.addEventListener('change', event => {\n
                    const target = event.target instanceof HTMLElement ? event.target : null;\n
                    const trigger = target?.closest('[data-signal-change-event]');\n
\n
                    if (! target || ! trigger) {\n
                        return;\n
                    }\n
\n
                    window.ilmu360.trackSignal(\n
                        trigger.dataset.signalChangeEvent,\n
                        {\n
                            ...baseProperties(trigger, target),\n
                            field_name: target.getAttribute('name') || target.id || null,\n
                            field_type: target.getAttribute('type') || target.tagName.toLowerCase(),\n
                            field_value: inputValue(target, trigger),\n
                        },\n
                        { category: trigger.dataset.signalCategory || null },\n
                    );\n
                }, true);\n
            })();\n
        </script>\n
        </head>\n

<body\n
    class="min-h-screen bg-background text-text-main font-sans antialiased selection:bg-emerald-500/30 selection:text-emerald-900">\n
    <div class="relative min-h-screen overflow-hidden">\n
        <!-- Background Gradients -->\n
        <div class="pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 z-0">\n
            <div class="absolute inset-0 opacity-[0.03]"\n
                style="background-image: url('https://ilmu360.test/images/pattern-bg.png'); background-size: 400px;">\n
            </div>\n
            <div\n
                class="absolute -top-40 left-[10%] h-[35rem] w-[35rem] rounded-full bg-emerald-500/10 blur-[100px] animate-pulse">\n
            </div>\n
            <div class="absolute top-20 right-[5%] h-[30rem] w-[30rem] rounded-full bg-teal-500/10 blur-[100px]"></div>\n
            <div\n
                class="absolute bottom-[-10rem] left-[20%] h-[40rem] w-[40rem] rounded-full bg-emerald-600/5 blur-[120px]">\n
            </div>\n
        </div>\n
\n
        <div class="relative z-10 flex flex-col min-h-screen">\n
            \n
            <!-- Premium Header -->\n
            <header\n
                class="sticky top-0 z-50 w-full border-b border-white/10 bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-md transition-all"\n
                x-data="{ mobileMenuOpen: false }">\n
                <nav class="container mx-auto flex h-20 items-center justify-between px-6 lg:px-12">\n
                    <a href="https://ilmu360.test" wire:navigate class="flex items-center group">\n
                        <img src="https://ilmu360.test/images/logo.png" alt="ilmu360°"\n
                            class="h-12 w-auto transition-transform group-hover:scale-105">\n
                    </a>\n

    id="app-toast-stack"\n

    x-data="{\n
        toasts: [],\n
        push(detail = {}) {\n
            if (!detail.message) {\n
                return;\n
            }\n
\n
            const toast = {\n
                id: detail.id ?? `${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(16).slice(2)}`,\n
                type: detail.type ?? 'success',\n
                title: detail.title ?? null,\n
                message: detail.message,\n
                timeout: Number(detail.timeout ?? (detail.type === 'error' ? 5200 : 4200)),\n
            };\n
\n
            this.toasts = [...this.toasts, toast];\n
            this.scheduleRemoval(toast.id, toast.timeout);\n
        },\n
        remove(id) {\n
            this.toasts = this.toasts.filter((toast) => toast.id !== id);\n
        },\n
        scheduleRemoval(id, timeout) {\n
            if (!timeout || timeout < 1) {\n
                return;\n
            }\n
\n
            window.setTimeout(() => this.remove(id), timeout);\n
        },\n
        init() {\n
            this.toasts.forEach((toast) => this.scheduleRemoval(toast.id, toast.timeout));\n
        },\n
    }"\n
    x-on:app-toast.window="push($event.detail ?? {})"\n

            identifyEndpoint: 'https:\/\/ilmu360.test\/api\/signals\/collect\/identify',\n
            anonymousCookieName: 'mi_signals_anonymous_id',\n
            sessionCookieName: 'mi_signals_session_id',\n
            writeKey: 'VZqGap3WgvlApv20u95VPL50WnwDTLawCE8mWIkT',\n
            externalId: '019f1e2a-ad72-70de-8c98-45c5b5e40e01',\n

        };\n
